features.summary: Set separate durations for the reveal's arrival and its departure.
features.where: Clip tab ▸ Text ▸ Reveal ▸ In, Out

features.name: Word styles replace the reveal
features.summary: On a word-styled caption page the Reveal section is greyed, because the word style decides how the words appear.

features.name: Bundled fonts
features.summary: Frame Job ships open-licensed faces that are always in the Family list.

features.name: Installed fonts and missing fonts
features.summary: A text clip can use any font family installed on the Mac, and a project using a font this Mac lacks still opens.

features.name: Add a shape clip
features.summary: Click Add Shape in the timeline bar and pick Rectangle, Ellipse, Line or Arrow to add one at the playhead.
features.where: Timeline bar ▸ Add Shape ▸ Rectangle, Ellipse, Line, Arrow

features.name: Rectangle
features.summary: A rectangle shape clip, and with a corner radius, a rounded rectangle.

features.name: Ellipse
features.summary: An ellipse shape clip that fills its box.

features.name: Line
features.summary: A straight line that starts diagonally across its box, with two ends you can drag.

features.name: Arrow
features.summary: A line with an arrowhead at its end.

features.name: Resize a shape with the handles
features.summary: Drag a handle to resize a shape's box, keeping the stroke's thickness. ⇧ frees the aspect ratio on a corner.
features.where: Drag a shape's handle on the canvas

features.name: Place a shape and add effects
features.summary: A shape also has a Picture sub-tab for its position, scale, rotation, opacity and effects.

features.name: Shape Kind
features.summary: Switch a shape between Rectangle, Ellipse, Line and Arrow.

features.name: Shape Width and Height
features.summary: Set the shape's box in pixels.
features.where: Clip tab ▸ Shape ▸ Shape ▸ Width, Height

features.name: Shape Corner radius
features.summary: Round a rectangle's corners.
features.where: Clip tab ▸ Shape ▸ Shape ▸ Corner radius

features.name: Shape Stroke
features.summary: Draw an outline around the shape.

features.name: Stroke Width
features.summary: Set the stroke's thickness.

features.name: Stroke Color
features.summary: Set the stroke's colour.

features.name: Shape Fill
features.summary: Fill a rectangle or ellipse with a flat colour.

features.name: Fill Color
features.summary: Set the fill's colour.

features.name: Fill Opacity
features.summary: Set how see-through the fill is.

features.name: Arrowheads
features.summary: Put a head on the start, the end or both ends of an arrow. Heads show only when Kind is Arrow.
features.where: Clip tab ▸ Shape ▸ Arrowheads ▸ Arrowhead at start, Arrowhead at end

features.name: Shape colours don't animate
features.summary: A shape's kind, stroke, fill, gradient and arrowheads cannot be animated; its position, scale and opacity can.

features.name: Change a shape from an agent
features.summary: An agent can change any of a shape's settings in one call and leave the rest as they are.

features.name: Drag a line or arrow endpoint
features.summary: A selected line or arrow has a round handle at each end that moves that end alone.
features.where: Drag a round end handle of a selected line or arrow on the canvas

features.name: Shape Gradient
features.summary: Fill a rectangle or ellipse with a colour ramp in place of the flat fill.

features.name: Gradient Kind
features.summary: Choose a Linear or Radial gradient.

features.name: Gradient Angle
features.summary: Set a linear gradient's direction, from 0 to 360°.

features.name: Gradient stops
features.summary: Each stop has a colour swatch, a position along the ramp and a Remove button.
features.where: Clip tab ▸ Shape ▸ Gradient ▸ Stop 1, Stop 2 and so on

features.name: Add Stop
features.summary: Add a stop in the middle of the widest gap, in the colour the ramp already has there, so the picture does not change.
features.where: Clip tab ▸ Shape ▸ Gradient ▸ Add Stop

features.name: Place an image on the timeline
features.summary: Import a picture as you would a movie, then drag it to a track or the canvas. It lands as a five-second clip.
features.where: Media tab ▸ drag a picture to a track or the canvas

features.name: Image clip length
features.summary: A picture has no length of its own, so an image clip can be trimmed to any duration.
features.where: Drag an image clip's edge on the timeline

features.name: Picture and Color controls on an image clip
features.summary: An image clip has every Picture section a video clip has but Layout and Cursor, and a Color sub-tab for grading.

features.name: Chroma Key
features.summary: Remove a background colour, such as a green screen, so what is on the tracks behind shows through.
features.where: Clip tab ▸ Picture ▸ Chroma Key ▸ Key out a color

features.name: Key Color
features.summary: Choose the colour to remove.
features.where: Clip tab ▸ Picture ▸ Chroma Key ▸ Key Color

features.name: Pick from Canvas
features.summary: Click the preview to sample the key colour; picking also turns the key on.
features.where: Clip tab ▸ Picture ▸ Chroma Key ▸ Pick from Canvas

features.name: Chroma Key Tolerance
features.summary: Set how far from the key colour still counts as background.
features.where: Clip tab ▸ Picture ▸ Chroma Key ▸ Tolerance

features.name: Chroma Key Softness
features.summary: Set how gradual the edge of the key is.
features.where: Clip tab ▸ Picture ▸ Chroma Key ▸ Softness

features.name: Chroma Key Spill
features.summary: Set how much of the key colour is removed from the soft edges that remain, which takes out a coloured fringe.
features.where: Clip tab ▸ Picture ▸ Chroma Key ▸ Spill

features.name: Remove Background
features.summary: Keep the person in a video or picture and make the rest transparent, with no green screen, upload or key.

features.name: Remove Background Subject
features.summary: For pictures, choose to keep the person or every foreground subject found, such as a pet or an object.
features.where: Clip tab ▸ Picture ▸ Background ▸ Subject: Person, Foreground

features.name: Background: Remove or Keep
features.summary: Draw the subject alone, or draw the whole clip and still let another clip go behind the subject.
features.where: Clip tab ▸ Picture ▸ Background ▸ Background: Remove, Keep

features.name: Remove Background Edge
features.summary: Pull the cut-out outline in or push it out.

features.name: Remove Background Feather
features.summary: Set how soft the cut-out outline is.

features.name: Why the Background rows are greyed
features.summary: Subject, Background, Edge and Feather stay greyed until every selected clip has Remove Background on.

features.name: Remove Background Status
features.summary: A read-out says how far the clip's masks have got, and why a clip is drawing whole.

features.name: Analyze Now
features.summary: Ask for the clip's masks again or retry after a failure, while a clip is analysing or has failed.
features.where: Clip tab ▸ Picture ▸ Background ▸ Analyze Now

features.name: Automatic, cached masks
features.summary: Masks are made on this Mac as soon as Remove Background is on, for the frames the clip plays, and kept in the project's cache.

features.name: Clip shows whole until its masks are ready
features.summary: In the preview, a clip with Remove Background on shows whole until a frame has its mask, then updates by itself.

features.name: Remove Background on pictures
features.summary: A picture's mask is made once on this Mac, from the picture as the preview draws it.

features.name: Exports wait for the masks
features.summary: With Background on Remove, an export draws the subject alone and waits, with no time limit, for every mask it needs.

features.name: Save Frame waits for the masks
features.summary: Saving a frame waits up to 30 seconds for the masks it needs, then saves the clip whole and tells you which files were.

features.name: Text Behind Subject
features.summary: Put a new title behind the person in a camera clip or photo in one step at the playhead.

features.name: Behind Subject by hand
features.summary: Put a title, shape, picture or graphic behind a subject yourself with one checkbox.
features.where: Clip tab ▸ Picture ▸ Behind Subject ▸ Behind subject

features.name: What cuts a clip behind the subject
features.summary: A clip with Behind subject on is cut, at every moment, by the subject of every cutout clip on a track behind it.

features.name: Note when nothing cuts the clip
features.summary: With one clip selected and Behind subject on, a note says when nothing cuts it at the playhead.

features.name: Drop Shadow
features.summary: Add a drop shadow cast by the clip's own shape: the picture, a text clip's letters, or a shape's outline and fill.
features.where: Clip tab ▸ Picture ▸ Shadow ▸ Drop shadow

features.name: Shadow Color
features.summary: Set the shadow's colour.

features.name: Shadow Opacity
features.summary: Set the shadow's strength.

features.name: Shadow Blur
features.summary: Soften the shadow.

features.name: Shadow Angle
features.summary: Set which way the shadow falls.

features.name: Shadow Distance
features.summary: Set how far the shadow falls.

features.name: Filter stack
features.summary: A clip can carry up to four filters.

features.name: Add Filter
features.summary: Add a Blur at 50 % to the end of the stack, ready to change to the filter you want.
features.where: Clip tab ▸ Picture ▸ Filters ▸ Add Filter

features.name: Filter order
features.summary: Move a filter by picking a number in its row; the order only changes the picture among Sepia, Noir, Vignette and Invert.
features.where: Clip tab ▸ Picture ▸ Filters ▸ number popup

features.name: Filter kind
features.summary: Change what a filter does, keeping its amount.
features.where: Clip tab ▸ Picture ▸ Filters ▸ kind popup

features.name: Filter Amount
features.summary: Set a filter's strength.

features.name: Remove Filter
features.summary: Take a filter off the clip.

features.name: Blur filter
features.summary: Soften the picture.
features.where: Clip tab ▸ Picture ▸ Filters ▸ kind popup ▸ Blur

features.name: Sharpen filter
features.summary: Crisp up edges and fine detail.
features.where: Clip tab ▸ Picture ▸ Filters ▸ kind popup ▸ Sharpen

features.name: Pixelate filter
features.summary: Break the picture into square blocks.
features.where: Clip tab ▸ Picture ▸ Filters ▸ kind popup ▸ Pixelate

features.name: Sepia filter
features.summary: Give the picture a warm old-photo tone.
features.where: Clip tab ▸ Picture ▸ Filters ▸ kind popup ▸ Sepia

features.name: Noir filter
features.summary: Turn the picture black and white and add contrast.
features.where: Clip tab ▸ Picture ▸ Filters ▸ kind popup ▸ Noir

features.name: Vignette filter
features.summary: Darken the picture towards its edges, in an ellipse fitted to the clip's cropped shape.
features.where: Clip tab ▸ Picture ▸ Filters ▸ kind popup ▸ Vignette

features.name: Invert filter
features.summary: Turn the picture into its negative.
features.where: Clip tab ▸ Picture ▸ Filters ▸ kind popup ▸ Invert

features.name: Filters on adjustment clips
features.summary: Paste Sepia, Noir, Vignette or Invert onto an adjustment clip, and it applies to everything behind that clip.

features.name: Filters in an action
features.summary: An action can ramp a filter's Amount; its kind and place switch at the action's end, and adding or removing isn't animated.
features.where: Clip tab ▸ Picture ▸ Filters with an action selected

features.name: Reflection
features.summary: Hang a mirrored copy of the clip under it, fading out.
features.where: Clip tab ▸ Picture ▸ Reflection ▸ Mirror the layer below itself

features.name: Reflection Opacity
features.summary: Set how strong the reflection is where it touches the clip.

features.name: Reflection Height
features.summary: Set how much of the clip is mirrored, as a share of its cropped height.

features.name: Reflection Gap
features.summary: Set the space between the clip and its reflection.

features.name: Reflection Falloff
features.summary: Set how far the reflection fades on its way down.

features.name: Spotlight
features.summary: Dim the clip outside a rectangle or ellipse, and optionally magnify what is inside.
features.where: Clip tab ▸ Picture ▸ Spotlight ▸ Spotlight a region

features.name: Spotlight Shape
features.summary: Choose a rectangle or an ellipse.
features.where: Clip tab ▸ Picture ▸ Spotlight ▸ Shape: Rectangle, Ellipse

features.name: Spotlight Center
features.summary: Place the spotlight on the clip's picture, measured from its centre.
features.where: Clip tab ▸ Picture ▸ Spotlight ▸ Center X, Center Y

features.name: Spotlight Size
features.summary: Set the spotlight's width and height.
features.where: Clip tab ▸ Picture ▸ Spotlight ▸ Width, Height

features.name: Spotlight Feather
features.summary: Soften the spotlight's edge.

features.name: Spotlight Dim
features.summary: Set how much darker everything outside the region is.

features.name: Spotlight Zoom
features.summary: Magnify what is inside the spotlight.

features.name: Obscure regions
features.summary: Hide a face, password field or phone number behind up to four blurred or pixelated regions per clip.

features.name: Add Region
features.summary: Add a 480 × 270 pixelated region at the centre of the clip.
features.where: Clip tab ▸ Picture ▸ Obscure ▸ Add Region

features.name: Place on Canvas
features.summary: Drag a rectangle over the selected clip to add a region there.
features.where: Clip tab ▸ Picture ▸ Obscure ▸ Place on Canvas

features.name: Region kind
features.summary: Choose Pixelate, which destroys the detail, or Blur, which only softens it.
features.where: Clip tab ▸ Picture ▸ Obscure ▸ Region N popup

features.name: Region shape
features.summary: Choose a rectangle or an ellipse for a region.
features.where: Clip tab ▸ Picture ▸ Obscure ▸ Region N ▸ Shape: Rectangle, Ellipse

features.name: Region Amount
features.summary: Set how strongly the region hides.
features.where: Clip tab ▸ Picture ▸ Obscure ▸ Region N ▸ Amount

features.name: Region Feather
features.summary: Ramp the effect in over the region's edge.
features.where: Clip tab ▸ Picture ▸ Obscure ▸ Region N ▸ Feather

features.name: Region Center
features.summary: Place a region as numbers, in the clip's own pixels from the centre of its picture.
features.where: Clip tab ▸ Picture ▸ Obscure ▸ Region N ▸ Center

features.name: Region Size
features.summary: Set a region's width and height as numbers.
features.where: Clip tab ▸ Picture ▸ Obscure ▸ Region N ▸ Size

features.name: Remove Region
features.summary: Take a region off the clip.
features.where: Clip tab ▸ Picture ▸ Obscure ▸ Region N ▸ Remove

features.name: Region grips on the canvas
features.summary: Move a selected clip's regions and resize them on the preview; hold ⌥ to resize about the centre.
features.where: Preview: drag a region's centre cross or handles

features.name: Animating a region
features.summary: A region's Amount, Feather, Center and Size can ramp over an action, so it can follow something across the shot.
features.where: Clip tab ▸ Picture ▸ Obscure with an action selected

features.name: Hide While Silent
features.summary: Fade a clip out in the pauses of a chosen file's speech and back in as it resumes.
features.where: Clip tab ▸ Picture ▸ Hide While Silent ▸ Hide while silent

features.name: Hide While Silent Speech from
features.summary: Pick which file's speech the clip follows.
features.where: Clip tab ▸ Picture ▸ Hide While Silent ▸ Speech from

features.name: Hide While Silent Pre-roll
features.summary: Set how long before each run of words the clip is fully back.
features.where: Clip tab ▸ Picture ▸ Hide While Silent ▸ Pre-roll

features.name: Hide While Silent Hold
features.summary: Set how long the clip stays after each run of words.
features.where: Clip tab ▸ Picture ▸ Hide While Silent ▸ Hold

features.name: Hide While Silent Fade
features.summary: Set how long the clip takes to fade out and in.
features.where: Clip tab ▸ Picture ▸ Hide While Silent ▸ Fade

features.name: When the followed file stops playing
features.summary: Where the followed file does not play at all, the clip shows, coming straight back with no fade.

features.name: Hide While Silent leaves Opacity alone
features.summary: The fade only touches the drawn picture, so the clip's own Opacity keeps its value.

features.name: The line on the timeline
features.summary: A teal line runs across a Hide While Silent clip on the timeline: at the top the clip shows, at the bottom it is hidden.

features.name: Actions
features.summary: A span of time on one clip over which its properties move to an end state you set, in place of keyframes.

features.name: An action holds its end state
features.summary: When an action's span is over, the clip keeps the end state until a later action changes it.

features.name: Action times are in clip time
features.summary: An action's times are measured from the clip's own start, not from the start of the timeline.

features.name: Several actions on one clip
features.summary: A clip can have as many actions as fit end to end, and they run in time order, each starting from the state the earlier ones left behind.

features.name: Action numbers
features.summary: Actions are numbered in time order, and the number is the same on the timeline and in the Clip tab.

features.name: Easing curves
features.summary: Four curves set how a value moves across an action or a transition: Linear, Ease In, Ease Out and Ease In Out.
features.where: Clip tab ▸ action lane ▸ detail row ▸ Curve

features.name: Default action curves
features.summary: A new action from Add Action is Linear, and a zoom action is Ease In Out.

features.name: Numbers ramp along the curve
features.summary: Numbers such as position, scale, opacity, volume and a grade's sliders move smoothly along the action's curve.

features.name: Switches, pop-ups and text change at the end
features.summary: An on/off box, a filter's kind, a font or a graphic's text or image holds its value, then switches when the action ends.
features.where: Clip tab, with an action selected

features.name: Lists ramp entry by entry
features.summary: Filter and obscure-region lists ramp entry by entry while both ends have the same number of entries.

features.name: Animate picture properties
features.summary: An action can animate almost every value in the Picture sub-tab, from transform and crop to shadow, spotlight and filter amounts.
features.where: Clip tab ▸ Picture with an action selected

features.name: Animate colour properties
features.summary: An action can animate Light, Color, Wheels, Curves and the Look amount, and on an adjustment clip its Strength and the Qualifier.
features.where: Clip tab ▸ Color with an action selected

features.name: Animate sound properties
features.summary: An action can animate the Sound sub-tab's Volume and Fades sections and every audio setting except the few that never animate.
features.where: Clip tab ▸ Sound with an action selected

features.name: Animate text properties
features.summary: An action can animate the Text sub-tab's style, size and colours.
features.where: Clip tab ▸ Text sub-tab with an action selected

features.name: Animate speed
features.summary: An action can change a media clip's playback rate, which makes a speed ramp, and hold the new rate after it ends.
features.where: Clip tab ▸ Clip ▸ Speed ▸ Rate with an action selected

features.name: What never animates
features.summary: Some rows change the clip itself whatever is selected, such as Motion presets and Ducking, and most are marked ⊘.

features.name: Colours blend in OKLab
features.summary: Colours that ramp blend through OKLab, which keeps the midpoints even and avoids the muddy middle of a straight RGB blend.

features.name: Add Action
features.summary: Add a 1-second action at the playhead on the selected clip, selected and ready to edit.

features.name: A new action starts empty
features.summary: A new action's end state is empty, so it changes nothing until you edit it.

features.name: When Add Action is available
features.summary: Add Action needs the playhead over a selected clip: the menu item greys out otherwise, and the lane's + button beeps.

features.name: Add Action with several clips selected
features.summary: With several clips selected, the action goes on the first selected clip under the playhead and is not selected.

features.name: When there's no room for an action
features.summary: Frame Job beeps and adds nothing when the action would overlap another action or run past the clip's end.

features.name: Other commands that make actions
features.summary: Zoom to Region, Speed Ramp, Auto Zoom, Follow Subject, Camera Layout and the volume line all make ordinary actions you can edit.

features.name: Click a band to select an action
features.summary: Click a band on the timeline or in the action lane to select its action, and the playhead moves to the action's end.
features.where: A band on the timeline, or Clip tab ▸ action lane

features.name: Adding an action selects it
features.summary: An action made with Add Action, Zoom to Region or Zoom Back is selected as it is added.

features.name: Play or scrub into an action
features.summary: Playing or scrubbing the playhead into an action's span selects it while its clip is the only one selected.
features.where: Move the playhead into an action's span

features.name: How a selected action looks
features.summary: The selected action's band is solid, a wash runs down the clip under its span, and the span is shaded on the ruler.

features.name: The Clip chip
features.summary: Highlighted while no action is selected. Click it to leave the action, so the fields edit the clip again.
features.where: Clip tab ▸ action lane ▸ Clip chip

features.name: Leave an action
features.summary: Press Esc, click the Clip chip or select a different clip to deselect an action, so the Clip tab shows the clip's own values again.

features.name: Selecting is not an edit
features.summary: Selecting an action is not an undo step and is not saved with the project.

features.name: Edit an action's end state
features.summary: While an action is selected, every field in the Clip tab shows and sets the values the clip reaches at the action's end.
features.where: Clip tab with an action selected

features.name: Edit an action's end state on the canvas
features.summary: With an action selected, moving, scaling, rotating or cropping on the canvas edits that action's end state instead of the clip.
features.where: The canvas, with an action selected

features.name: Switch a property off at an action's end
features.summary: Untick a switch inside an action, such as Drop shadow or Outline, and that property turns off when the action ends.
features.where: Clip tab checkbox with an action selected

features.name: Set an action's end state as an agent
features.summary: An agent sets an action's end state with set_action_end, and what it sends merges into what the action already holds.

features.name: Row marks
features.summary: A narrow gutter on each Clip tab row shows how it relates to the selected action.

features.name: The "at end" tag
features.summary: A control that can't blend, such as a pop-up or a checkbox, says "at end": it holds until the action's end, then switches.

features.name: Sliders inside an action
features.summary: A slider's rail fills in the action colour from the action's start value to the knob, and a coral tick marks the playhead's value.

features.name: The "now …" tag
features.summary: A row with no slider shows the value at the playhead in a coral tag, such as "now 1.50×".

features.name: Section header marks
features.summary: Section headers carry the same marks as rows, with a ◆N count, and a section where every row is ⊘ says so.

features.name: Clear a section from an action
features.summary: Click Clear in a section's header to take that whole section out of the selected action.

features.name: Sub-tab ◆N counts
features.summary: Each sub-tab's label shows ◆N when the selected action animates N things on it.

features.name: Animated sections open by themselves
features.summary: Selecting an action opens the sections it animates on the current sub-tab, for as long as that action stays selected.

features.name: Take a property out of an action
features.summary: Hover over a ◆ and click the × that replaces it to take that row out of the selected action.

features.name: The row menu
features.summary: Right-click an inspector row to take it out of the action, go to the action that animates it, or put it back to its default.
features.where: Right-click a row in the Clip tab

features.name: Drag a band to move an action
features.summary: Drag a band's body on the timeline or in the action lane to move the action within its clip.
features.where: A band on the timeline, or Clip tab ▸ action lane

features.name: Drag a band's grips to resize an action
features.summary: Drag either end of a band to move that end of the action. The 5 pt grips show on hover.
features.where: A band on the timeline, or Clip tab ▸ action lane

features.name: What a band drag stops at
features.summary: A band drag snaps to whole frames, keeps the action at least one frame long, and stops at neighbouring actions and the clip's ends.

features.name: The drag readout
features.summary: While you drag, a readout gives the band's new times and offset, or the change in length in frames.

features.name: Drag in the Clip tab's lane
features.summary: The Clip tab's lane moves and resizes bands the same way as the timeline, and selects the action when you let go.

features.name: Zero-length actions
features.summary: A zero-length action shows only in the Clip tab's lane, where you can select it but not drag it.

features.name: Action Start
features.summary: Type where the action starts, as a timecode measured from the clip's own start.
features.where: Clip tab ▸ action lane ▸ detail row ▸ Start

features.name: Action Length
features.summary: Type how long the action takes, in seconds, snapped to whole frames.
features.where: Clip tab ▸ action lane ▸ detail row ▸ Length

features.name: Action Curve
features.summary: Pick how the action eases from its start to its end state, with a small glyph of the curve beside the pop-up.
features.where: Clip tab ▸ action lane ▸ detail row ▸ Curve

features.name: Change an action as an agent
features.summary: Agents move an action, change its length or change its curve with set_action.

features.name: Why an action edit didn't work
features.summary: When Frame Job won't take a typed Start, Length or end value, it beeps and gives the reason at the foot of the inspector.

features.name: Remove an action
features.summary: With an action selected, press ⌫ or click the trash button in the action lane to remove only the action, not the clip.
features.where: Edit ▸ Delete, with an action selected

features.name: Ripple Delete still deletes the clip
features.summary: ⌘⌫ deletes the whole selected clip and closes the gap, even while an action is selected.

features.name: Action bands on the timeline
features.summary: Each clip that has an action shows an action lane directly under its name strip, with one numbered band per action.

features.name: What a band shows at each track height
features.summary: How much a band shows depends on View ▸ Timeline Track Height.

features.name: Band hover
features.summary: Pointing at a band highlights it and shows its grips.
features.where: Hover a band on the timeline or in the Clip tab's lane

features.name: The Clip tab's action lane
features.summary: A small timeline of the selected clip in the Clip tab shows the Clip chip, its actions as numbered bands in time order, and the playhead.

features.name: The lane's header row
features.summary: The header shows ACTIONS, the count or "none", "· editing N" while action N is selected, and three buttons.
features.where: Clip tab ▸ action lane ▸ header row

features.name: Transition, fades and motion in the lane
features.summary: Under the bands the lane draws the clip's hatched transition overlap, its audio fades and its motion wedges, the same marks the timeline draws.

features.name: The lane's detail row
features.summary: Shown only while an action is selected, with Start, Length, Curve and the trash button.
features.where: Clip tab ▸ action lane ▸ detail row

features.name: The lane with several clips selected
features.summary: With several clips selected the lane reads "Select one clip to edit its actions."

features.name: Trimming and actions
features.summary: Trimming a clip's start keeps its actions' clip time, and trimming its end leaves them in place, so one can run past the new end.

features.name: Slip, Roll and actions
features.summary: Slip and Roll leave actions where they are in clip time.

features.name: Speed changes and actions
features.summary: Changing the speed or rate-stretching keeps a clip's actions at their place as a fraction of the clip.

features.name: Splitting and actions
features.summary: On a split, actions after the cut go to the second half, and one that spans the cut is divided between the halves.

features.name: Adding a transition and actions
features.summary: Adding a transition at a hard cut moves the incoming clip's actions with its new first frame, so a zoom stays on the frame it was drawn over.

features.name: Copies keep their actions
features.summary: Duplicate, Copy and Paste give copies that keep their actions.

features.name: Nesting keeps actions
features.summary: Nested clips keep their actions inside the nest.

features.name: Freeze Frame bakes actions
features.summary: A freeze frame's still has no actions, and the look at the frozen frame is baked into its own properties.

features.name: Blurred Background has no actions
features.summary: The backdrop copy has no actions, so a zoom on the foreground doesn't zoom the backdrop.

features.name: Paste Attributes skips actions
features.summary: Paste Attributes does not copy actions.

features.name: What keeps or drops motion presets
features.summary: Freeze Frame and Add Blurred Background drop a clip's motion presets, while Duplicate, Detach Audio and Paste keep them.

features.name: Properties a graphic no longer has
features.summary: When a graphic's module changes, a property it no longer has or lets animate shows dimmed, with ⌫ to take it out of the action.

features.name: Zoom to Region
features.summary: Draw a rectangle on the picture and the clip zooms so that rectangle fills the frame: the screencast zoom, added as an action.
features.where: Clip tab ▸ action lane ▸ zoom-in magnifier

features.name: The canvas hint and outline
features.summary: While you draw, a hint gives the keys and a second outline shows exactly what the canvas will show once the zoom lands.
features.where: Canvas, in Zoom to Region mode

features.name: Fit or fill
features.summary: By default the whole rectangle is shown; hold ⇧ while dragging to fill the canvas instead.
features.where: ⇧ while dragging in Zoom to Region mode

features.name: The scale limit
features.summary: The zoom stops at 1,000%, the largest scale a layer can take, and the rectangle stays centred even then.

features.name: Leaving Zoom to Region
features.summary: Press Esc, press Z again or click the zoom-in magnifier again to leave the mode.

features.name: Which clip can be zoomed
features.summary: The mode needs exactly one selected clip drawn at the playhead and not on a locked track; otherwise Z beeps.

features.name: A zoom on a clip with a During preset
features.summary: On a clip with a During preset, a second hint warns that the zoom is worked out without it, so the rectangle won't sit exactly in place.
features.where: Canvas, in Zoom to Region mode

features.name: Zoom Back
features.summary: Add a 1-second Ease In Out action back to the clip's own scale and position, to pull out after a zoom.
features.where: Clip tab ▸ action lane ▸ zoom-out magnifier

features.name: Auto Zoom
features.summary: Clip ▸ Auto Zoom… plans these same zoom actions for a screen recording from its cursor file.

features.name: Motion presets
features.summary: Give a clip a ready-made entrance, exit or continuous movement tied to its two ends, so it moves with a trim.

features.name: Motion sits on top of placement
features.summary: Motion is applied on top of the clip's own placement and any actions, relative to the clip.

features.name: The inspector shows un-moved values
features.summary: The Clip tab's fields show the clip's own, un-moved values, even though the preview and export show it moving.

features.name: The Motion presets section
features.summary: The section at the end of the Clip sub-tab holds In, In Duration, Out, Out Duration, During, Amount, Period and Preview.

features.name: In
features.summary: Choose how a clip enters, or None.
features.where: Clip tab ▸ Clip ▸ Motion presets ▸ In

features.name: In Duration
features.summary: Set how long the entrance takes, from 0.1 to 10 s.
features.where: Clip tab ▸ Clip ▸ Motion presets ▸ In Duration

features.name: Out
features.summary: Choose how a clip leaves, or None.
features.where: Clip tab ▸ Clip ▸ Motion presets ▸ Out

features.name: Out Duration
features.summary: Set how long the exit takes, from 0.1 to 10 s.
features.where: Clip tab ▸ Clip ▸ Motion presets ▸ Out Duration

features.name: The Clip ▸ Motion menu
features.summary: Each of In, Out and During lists its kinds, then None to clear the slot, and works on every selected clip that has a picture.

features.name: Changing a kind keeps its settings
features.summary: Changing a slot's kind keeps the duration, amount and period it already had.

features.name: Reset
features.summary: The section's Reset clears all three slots on every selected clip.
features.where: Clip tab ▸ Clip ▸ Motion presets ▸ Reset

features.name: Presets across several clips
features.summary: With several clips selected, a change to one slot leaves each clip's other slots as they were.

features.name: Preview
features.summary: Set the in/out range to the clip, turn Loop on and play it, so you can watch its motion.

features.name: Set presets as an agent
features.summary: Agents set or clear a clip's motion presets through set_video.

features.name: Motion marks on the timeline
features.summary: Small marks on a clip's name strip show its active motion: a wedge at each end for an In or Out, and a wave symbol for a During.

features.name: Overlong presets shorten
features.summary: When In and Out together outlast the clip, both shorten in proportion, so the entrance ends on the frame where the exit begins.

features.name: Inactive presets
features.summary: An In or Out with zero duration, which can come from an agent, is kept but does nothing, and is marked so you can fix it.

features.name: Presets are not part of an action
features.summary: Motion rows are marked ⊘ and always change the clip, even with an action selected.

features.name: Splitting a clip with presets
features.summary: A split gives the first half no Out and the second half no In, so the cut doesn't play an exit and an entrance.

features.name: Speed changes leave presets alone
features.summary: Changing the speed doesn't rescale a clip's motion presets.

features.name: Dragging during motion
features.summary: A canvas drag started mid-motion starts from the clip's un-moved position.

features.name: How In and Out relate
features.summary: The same nine kinds fill both slots as a pair, not a rewind: an In slows as the clip arrives, and an Out speeds up as it leaves.

features.name: Fade
features.summary: Fades the clip in or out.
features.where: Clip tab ▸ Clip ▸ Motion presets ▸ In or Out

features.name: Zoom In
features.summary: Grows the clip while fading it, from 60% on the way in and to 140% on the way out.
features.where: Clip tab ▸ Clip ▸ Motion presets ▸ In or Out

features.name: Zoom Out
features.summary: Shrinks the clip while fading it, from 140% on the way in and to 60% on the way out.
features.where: Clip tab ▸ Clip ▸ Motion presets ▸ In or Out

features.name: Slide Left
features.summary: Moves the clip leftward as it arrives or leaves.
features.where: Clip tab ▸ Clip ▸ Motion presets ▸ In or Out

features.name: Slide Right
features.summary: Moves the clip rightward as it arrives or leaves.
features.where: Clip tab ▸ Clip ▸ Motion presets ▸ In or Out

features.name: Slide Up
features.summary: Moves the clip upward as it arrives or leaves.
features.where: Clip tab ▸ Clip ▸ Motion presets ▸ In or Out

features.name: Slide Down
features.summary: Moves the clip downward as it arrives or leaves.
features.where: Clip tab ▸ Clip ▸ Motion presets ▸ In or Out

features.name: Spin (In and Out)
features.summary: Makes half a turn clockwise as the clip arrives or leaves, scaling between 30% and full size and fading.
features.where: Clip tab ▸ Clip ▸ Motion presets ▸ In or Out

features.name: Pop
features.summary: Springs the clip past full size as it arrives or leaves.
features.where: Clip tab ▸ Clip ▸ Motion presets ▸ In or Out

features.name: Slides measure the drawn layer
features.summary: A slide measures the layer as it is drawn, so it starts or ends exactly off the edge of the canvas, or of the nest it is inside.

features.name: Slides on text clips
features.summary: A text clip has no measured size, so a slide starts or ends half a canvas past the edge, which clears any text narrower than the canvas.

features.name: During
features.summary: Choose what a clip does all the way through, or None.
features.where: Clip tab ▸ Clip ▸ Motion presets ▸ During

features.name: Amount
features.summary: Set how strong the During movement is, from 0 to 100%.
features.where: Clip tab ▸ Clip ▸ Motion presets ▸ Amount

features.name: Period
features.summary: Set how long one During cycle takes, from 0.1 to 10 s.
features.where: Clip tab ▸ Clip ▸ Motion presets ▸ Period

features.name: Pulse
features.summary: Gently grows and shrinks once per period.
features.where: Clip tab ▸ Clip ▸ Motion presets ▸ During

features.name: Shake
features.summary: Jitters in a pattern that never visibly repeats.
features.where: Clip tab ▸ Clip ▸ Motion presets ▸ During

features.name: Spin (During)
features.summary: Turns clockwise without stopping.
features.where: Clip tab ▸ Clip ▸ Motion presets ▸ During

features.name: Bounce
features.summary: Hops upward once per period.
features.where: Clip tab ▸ Clip ▸ Motion presets ▸ During

features.name: Drift
features.summary: A slow push-in across the whole clip.
features.where: Clip tab ▸ Clip ▸ Motion presets ▸ During

features.name: During starts from the clip's placement
features.summary: Every During movement starts from the clip's own placement on its first frame.

features.name: During runs under In and Out
features.summary: A During movement runs under the In and Out, so a clip can slide in while it pulses.

features.name: During restarts at each cut
features.summary: A During movement restarts at each cut, so Remove Silences on a clip with Pulse or Drift can make it jump at the cuts.

features.name: Motion Blur
features.summary: Blur a moving clip along its path, set as the shutter's share of one frame.
features.where: Clip tab ▸ Picture ▸ Transform ▸ Motion Blur

features.name: The same in preview and export
features.summary: The blur is the same in the preview, Save Frame, every export and a frame an agent renders.

features.name: Motion Blur animates
features.summary: Motion Blur can change inside an action, so a blur can ramp in and out.
features.where: Clip tab ▸ Picture ▸ Transform ▸ Motion Blur, with an action selected

features.name: Motion blur with blend modes
features.summary: A blended clip blends its averaged picture once, so a screened clip screens its blurred picture over what is under it.

features.name: Where motion blur stays sharp
features.summary: A clip in a transition, on a matte track, cut by Text Behind Subject or with a drop shadow draws sharp, whatever the row says.

features.name: No motion blur on nests or adjustment clips
features.summary: The row is greyed on a nest clip, so set the blur on the clips inside. An adjustment clip has no Picture sub-tab, so no row.
features.where: Clip tab ▸ Picture ▸ Transform ▸ Motion Blur

features.name: Transitions
features.summary: A transition plays across the overlap between two clips on the same track.

features.name: The overlap rules
features.summary: Clips on a track overlap only as a transition: at most one neighbour on each side, and at most half the shorter clip.

features.name: Overlapping two clips adds a Cross Dissolve
features.summary: When an edit makes a clip overlap the one before it, with no transition stored, Frame Job adds an eased, crossfading Cross Dissolve.
features.where: Drag a clip onto its neighbour

features.name: An overlap with no stored transition
features.summary: Choosing None keeps the overlap, which blends as a linear cross dissolve with no hatch and no sound crossfade until the next move or trim.

features.name: The transition zone on clips
features.summary: The overlap between two clips draws as a hatched zone across the cut, with the transition's name in it when the word fits.

features.name: A transition needs an overlap
features.summary: A transition stored on a clip that overlaps nothing does nothing until there is an overlap.

features.name: Cross Dissolve
features.summary: The outgoing clip fades into the incoming one.

features.name: Fade Through Black
features.summary: The outgoing clip fades to black over the first half, then the incoming one fades up from black over the second half.

features.name: Fade Through White
features.summary: The outgoing clip fades to white, then the incoming one fades up from white.

features.name: Push Left
features.summary: Both clips move: the outgoing leaves to the left as the incoming pushes in from the right.

features.name: Push Right
features.summary: The outgoing leaves to the right and the incoming comes in from the left.

features.name: Push Up
features.summary: The outgoing leaves upward and the incoming comes up from the bottom.

features.name: Push Down
features.summary: The outgoing leaves downward and the incoming comes down from the top.

features.name: Wipe
features.summary: An edge sweeps left to right, revealing the incoming clip.

features.name: Slide
features.summary: The incoming clip slides in from the right over the outgoing one, which stays put.

features.name: Zoom
features.summary: The outgoing clip grows toward you to 125% while the incoming one grows into place from 75%, and the two dissolve into each other.

features.name: Wipe Left
features.summary: An edge sweeps right to left.

features.name: Wipe Up
features.summary: An edge sweeps upward.

features.name: Wipe Down
features.summary: An edge sweeps downward.

features.name: Wipes on clips of different sizes
features.summary: A wipe's edge is measured in each clip's own frame, so two clips of different sizes don't meet at one line.

features.name: Fades through a colour on small layers
features.summary: On a picture-in-picture, a fade through a colour shows a black or white box over what's behind it, not a see-through fade.

features.name: The Clip ▸ Transition menu
features.summary: Apply a chosen style to every selected clip at once.

features.name: Restyle an existing overlap
features.summary: A clip that already overlaps the clip before it gets the chosen style, keeping its curve and crossfade.

features.name: A transition at a hard cut
features.summary: A clip that starts where the previous one ends gets a half-second overlap centred on the cut, from footage the clips aren't showing.

features.name: Clips that are skipped
features.summary: A clip after a gap, or the first clip on its track, is skipped by Clip ▸ Transition.

features.name: When there is no footage to spare
features.summary: When two clips use their whole files, Clip ▸ Transition shows a sheet offering to make the overlap another way.

features.name: Shift Clips Left
features.summary: Make the overlap by sliding the second clip, and everything after it on unlocked tracks, left by half a second.

features.name: Set or clear a transition as an agent
features.summary: Agents set a style on a clip that already overlaps, or clear it, with set_transition.

features.name: Remove a transition
features.summary: Choose None to remove the stored transition. The overlap stays, so move or trim the clips to get a hard cut back.

features.name: The Transition section
features.summary: An inspector section on the Clip sub-tab, shown when a single selected clip overlaps the clip before it.

features.name: Kind
features.summary: Choose how a clip meets the one before it where they overlap, or None.

features.name: Curve
features.summary: Choose how the transition's progress is eased.

features.name: Duration
features.summary: Set the overlap's length, from 0.02 to 10 s, which moves the later clip to match.

features.name: Transition alignment
features.summary: A new overlap is centred on the cut, and an agent can take its footage from one side instead.

features.name: Default transition values
features.summary: A transition Frame Job makes is eased with Ease In Out and crossfades its sound.

features.name: Which clips take speed
features.summary: Speed…, Fit to, rate stretch, ramps, Reverse and Freeze Frame need a video or audio clip; only Retime Range also reaches other clips.

features.name: Rate range ×0.1 to ×1000
features.summary: A clip can play anywhere from a tenth of normal speed to a thousand times normal.

features.name: Speed limits at a glance
features.summary: A clip keeps its sound up to ×12, rates run from ×0.1 to ×1000, and a freeze frame lasts 2 s.

features.name: The Speed sheet
features.summary: Clip ▸ Speed… sets the playback rate of the selected media clips and shows the result before you apply it.

features.name: Speed sheet: Rate
features.summary: Type the playback rate as a number: 1 is normal, 2 is twice as fast, 0.5 is half speed.

features.name: Speed sheet: Presets
features.summary: A pull-down that fills in Rate with a common speed.

features.name: Speed sheet: the readout
features.summary: A readout shows the clip count, the total length before and after, each transition affected, and a note for ramped clips.

features.name: Speed sheet: Apply
features.summary: Apply sets the rate on every listed clip as one undo step, Set Speed.

features.name: A speed change keeps the clip's start
features.summary: A constant speed change keeps the clip's start and changes its length, so a faster clip can leave a gap that later clips do not close.

features.name: A slowed clip overlapping the next clip
features.summary: A slowed clip that runs into the next gives that clip a transition across the overlap, or keeps its old speed if the overlap isn't allowed.

features.name: Fit to
features.summary: Type a length in the Speed section and the rate changes so the clip plays in that time, within the ×0.1 to ×1000 limits.
features.where: Clip tab ▸ Clip ▸ Speed section ▸ Fit to

features.name: The new length snaps to a whole frame
features.summary: After a speed change the clip's length snaps to a whole frame and never runs past the end of the file at the new rate.

features.name: When Fit to is unavailable
features.summary: Fit to changes the whole clip even with an action selected, shows only for media clips, and won't change a clip linked to detached sound.
features.where: Clip tab ▸ Clip ▸ Speed section ▸ Fit to

features.name: The Speed section
features.summary: When every selected clip is a media clip, the Clip tab's Clip sub-tab has a Speed section holding Rate, Keep pitch and Fit to.

features.name: Speed section: Rate
features.summary: Sets the rate, from ×0.1 to ×1000, on every selected media clip. A value past a limit is set to the nearest limit.
features.where: Clip tab ▸ Clip ▸ Speed section ▸ Rate

features.name: Speed section: Rate quick picks
features.summary: The chevron at the end of the Rate field opens a menu of 0.50×, 1.00×, 2.00× and 4.00×.
features.where: Clip tab ▸ Clip ▸ Speed section ▸ the chevron on Rate

features.name: Speed section: Keep pitch
features.summary: The same setting as the Speed sheet's Preserve pitch, on every selected media clip. It also brings them all to the first clip's rate.
features.where: Clip tab ▸ Clip ▸ Speed section ▸ Keep pitch

features.name: Speed section: Reset
features.summary: Reset in the section header sets the rate back to ×1.
features.where: Clip tab ▸ Clip ▸ Speed section ▸ Reset

features.name: Rate inside an action
features.summary: While an action is selected, Rate shows and sets the rate that action ends on, which turns any action into a Speed action.
features.where: Clip tab ▸ Clip ▸ Speed section ▸ Rate

features.name: Clear a rate from an action
features.summary: Take the rate out of an action, and keep the action, with the header's Clear, the row's × on hover, or right-click Remove from action N.
features.where: Clip tab ▸ Clip ▸ Speed section ▸ Clear

features.name: Keep pitch and Fit to stay the clip's in an action
features.summary: Keep pitch and Fit to change the clip itself even with an action selected, so they're marked ⊘ and never animate.

features.name: Rate stretch
features.summary: Hold ⌥ and drag a media clip's end edge to change its length by changing its speed, so it still plays all of the source it showed.
features.where: Timeline: ⌥-drag a media clip's end edge

features.name: Rate stretch snapping
features.summary: A rate stretch snaps like any other edge drag; hold ⌘ to turn snapping off.
features.where: Timeline: ⌥-drag a media clip's end edge

features.name: Which edges and clips stretch
features.summary: Only the end edge of a media clip stretches; every other case falls back to an ordinary trim or does nothing.

features.name: Rate stretch of a ramped clip
features.summary: On a clip with a speed ramp the whole ramp stretches with the clip and keeps its shape.

features.name: Keep pitch
features.summary: A per-clip setting, on by default, that decides whether sound keeps its own pitch at a new speed or follows the speed like tape.
features.where: Clip tab ▸ Clip ▸ Speed section ▸ Keep pitch

features.name: Speed sheet: Preserve pitch
features.summary: Keeps the sound at its own pitch at the new speed; off, the pitch rises and falls with the speed.

features.name: Tape-pitch audio is rendered in the background
features.summary: With Keep pitch off at any rate but ×1, up to ×12, the clip's sound is rendered first, so it's silent in the preview until that finishes.
features.where: Clip tab ▸ Clip ▸ Speed section ▸ Keep pitch

features.name: Sound is left out above ×12
features.summary: A clip played faster than ×12 goes silent in the preview and the export while its picture keeps playing, and Frame Job asks first.

features.name: The ×12 rule on ramped clips
features.summary: On a ramped clip, one rate above ×12 anywhere in the ramp silences the whole clip, not only the fast part.

features.name: The ×12 alert
features.summary: Before an edit takes a clip with sound from ×12 or below to above ×12, an alert asks first.

features.name: ×12 alert: Set Speed
features.summary: Makes the edit exactly as you asked, and keeps this name when the edit is a ramp or a stretch.

features.name: ×12 alert: Cancel
features.summary: Changes nothing and adds no undo step, and a sheet that asked stays open.

features.name: Where the ×12 alert appears
features.summary: The alert can come from the Speed, Speed Ramp, Retime Range and Speed Up Typing sheets, the Speed section and the ⌥ rate stretch.

features.name: The silent audio note
features.summary: The Speed section shows "Audio is silent above ×12" when a selected clip with sound is past the audio limit.

features.name: Agents and the ×12 limit
features.summary: An agent is never asked: its edit goes through, and the result lists the clips that went silent.

features.name: Speed ramps
features.summary: A clip's rate can change over time, for example ×1 up to ×4 over half a second, a hold, then back down.

features.name: Speed actions
features.summary: A ramp is made of ordinary actions on the clip's action lane whose end sets a rate.

features.name: A ramped clip keeps its place and length
features.summary: A ramp changes how much of the file plays, not the clip's start, its end or the clips around it.

features.name: The rate line
features.summary: A white line across the action lane draws the clip's rate over its length, higher where it plays faster.

features.name: The speed band label
features.summary: At the Large track height, a Speed action's band on the timeline is labelled speed.

features.name: A ramp never plays past the media's end
features.summary: An edit that would make a ramp play past the end of the file isn't made, and the reason says what would fit.

features.name: The Speed Ramp sheet
features.summary: Clip ▸ Speed Ramp… makes a whole ramp in one step on one selected media clip, out of ordinary Speed actions.

features.name: The span a ramp covers
features.summary: The ramp covers the timeline's in/out range if it lies entirely inside the clip, otherwise the whole clip.

features.name: Speed Ramp sheet: Shape
features.summary: Picks one of the four shapes; choosing a shape resets Rate to that shape's default.

features.name: Ramp Up
features.summary: One action over the span, rising from the current rate to the target and holding it after.

features.name: Ramp Down
features.summary: One action over the span, falling to the target and holding it after.

features.name: Speed Dip
features.summary: Two actions: a ramp down to the target at the start of the span, a hold, and a ramp back to the starting rate at its end.

features.name: Speed Burst
features.summary: Two actions: a ramp up to the target at the start of the span, a hold, and a ramp back to the starting rate at its end.

features.name: Speed Ramp sheet: Rate
features.summary: The target rate the ramp reaches, from ×0.1 to ×1000, with the same Presets as the Speed sheet.

features.name: Speed Ramp sheet: Curve
features.summary: How each new action eases: Ease In Out or Linear.

features.name: Speed Ramp sheet: Hold
features.summary: For Speed Dip and Speed Burst, how much of the span stays at the rate: None, 25%, 50% or 75%.

features.name: Speed Ramp sheet: the live readout
features.summary: The sheet tries the ramp on every change, including each keystroke in Rate, and shows the shape, the span and the rates it would make.

features.name: Speed Ramp sheet: Apply
features.summary: Adds the actions as one undo step named after the shape, for example Speed Dip.

features.name: When Speed Ramp's Apply is unavailable
features.summary: Apply is dimmed if the span overlaps an action or is too short, the rate is on the wrong side, the clip is linked, or the file runs out.

features.name: Build a ramp by hand
features.summary: Add actions at the playhead and give each an end rate to shape a ramp one change at a time.

features.name: Move and resize a Speed action
features.summary: Drag the band on the action lane to move it, or drag its edges to resize it.

features.name: Speed action curve
features.summary: Choose how an action eases, Linear, In, Out or In Out, in the detail row under the Clip tab's action lane.
features.where: Clip tab ▸ action lane detail row ▸ curve pop-up

features.name: The playhead selects the action
features.summary: With one clip selected, playing or scrubbing into an action selects it.

features.name: Back to editing the clip
features.summary: Press Esc, or choose the Clip chip on the Clip tab's action lane, to go back to editing the clip itself.
features.where: Clip tab ▸ action lane ▸ Clip chip

features.name: Splitting inside a Speed action
features.summary: A split inside a Speed action keeps the picture continuous at the cut, with no repeated or skipped frame.

features.name: Scaling a whole ramp
features.summary: Speed…, Rate with no action selected, Fit to, the ⌥ rate stretch and Retime Range scale a whole ramp by one factor, keeping its shape.

features.name: Edits follow the ramp
features.summary: Trims, slips, rolls, splits, freeze frames and transitions read the ramp, so each lands on the frame actually playing at that moment.

features.name: Filmstrip and waveform follow the ramp
features.summary: A ramped clip's filmstrip and waveform on the timeline follow the ramp.

features.name: A Speed action past the clip's end
features.summary: An action left past the clip's end stays on it and still counts for ×12. While its band shows, you can change its curve, move or shorten it.

features.name: When a ramp edit can't be made
features.summary: Nothing changes, and the reason shows at the foot of the inspector, or in the Speed Ramp sheet's readout.

features.name: Rendered audio
features.summary: Ramped clips, and constant clips at any rate but ×1 with Keep pitch off, have their sound rendered in the background.

features.name: Undo and redo render again
features.summary: Undo and redo usually render the clip's sound again, because the older file is dropped, so the clip is briefly silent then too.

features.name: Ramp sound with Keep pitch off
features.summary: The sound glides smoothly up and down in pitch with the rate, like tape, and stays in step with the picture.
features.where: Clip tab ▸ Clip ▸ Speed section ▸ Keep pitch

features.name: Ramp sound with Keep pitch on
features.summary: The sound keeps its own pitch as the speed changes. After a steep slow-down it can run up to about 24 ms behind the picture.
features.where: Clip tab ▸ Clip ▸ Speed section ▸ Keep pitch

features.name: Silent in the preview while rendering
features.summary: While a clip's sound is still rendering, that clip plays silent in the preview.

features.name: Exports wait for rendered audio
features.summary: An export waits for every render it needs and never writes that sound silent. The Exporting sheet reads Preparing during the wait.

features.name: A failed audio render
features.summary: If a render fails, an export that needs it fails naming the clip, and the clip stays silent until its timing changes or Frame Job is reopened.

features.name: Captions follow a speed change
features.summary: When a clip with sound changes speed, or a Speed action on it changes, the captions over it move with its speech in the same undo step.

features.name: Which captions move
features.summary: Only text clips on an unlocked, text-only track named Captions or Captions N, lying wholly inside the edited clip, are re-timed.

features.name: Speech the clip no longer plays
features.summary: A caption whose speech the clip no longer reaches is removed; a word caption page only partly reached keeps the words that still play.

features.name: Moved captions and their neighbours
features.summary: A moved caption is cut back where it would run into a caption that did not move.

features.name: Retime Range
features.summary: Clip ▸ Retime Range… plays the In–Out range faster or slower on every unlocked track at once and moves everything after Out to stay in step.

features.name: Retime Range inside a nest
features.summary: Retime Range works inside a nest, where it retimes the nest's own tracks.

features.name: Retime Range sheet: Rate
features.summary: How much faster the range plays, from ×0.1 to ×1000, starting at ×2, with the Speed sheet's presets.

features.name: Retime Range sheet: Preserve pitch
features.summary: Sets the pitch setting on every video or audio clip in the range.

features.name: Retime Range sheet: Apply
features.summary: Apply at ×1 closes the sheet and changes nothing. At any other rate it retimes the range.

features.name: Clips across an edge are cut
features.summary: A clip that crosses In or Out is cut there first, as Split cuts it.

features.name: Rates multiply
features.summary: Each video or audio clip inside plays at its own rate times the Rate, and a ramp keeps its shape with every rate scaled.

features.name: Titles, shapes and stills stretch too
features.summary: Titles, shapes, stills, images, graphics and adjustment clips inside are stretched or squeezed by the same amount.

features.name: Actions keep their place
features.summary: Actions keep their place in each clip, at the same fraction of its length.

features.name: Markers and detached sound
features.summary: Markers inside the range move with the picture, markers after it move with everything else, and a detached sound moves with its linked clip.

features.name: When a range cannot be retimed
features.summary: Nothing changes and the reason appears at the foot of the inspector when the range cannot be retimed.

features.name: Reverse a clip
features.summary: A checkbox plays the clip back to front, picture and sound, or forwards again.
features.where: Clip tab ▸ Clip ▸ Timing section ▸ Reverse

features.name: Reverse in the Timing section
features.summary: With one clip selected Timing shows In, Out and Duration above the Reverse rows; with several media clips, only the Reverse rows.

features.name: Reversed frames
features.summary: A row shows where the backwards copy has got to: Rendering…, Rendered, Not rendered or Media missing.
features.where: Clip tab ▸ Clip ▸ Timing section ▸ Reversed frames

features.name: Render Reverse
features.summary: Starts the render again after it was cancelled or failed.
features.where: Clip tab ▸ Clip ▸ Timing section ▸ Render Reverse

features.name: Reversing keeps the clip in place
features.summary: Reversing never moves the clip: it keeps its start, its length and its in point.
features.where: Clip tab ▸ Clip ▸ Timing section ▸ Reverse

features.name: Reverse with speed and ramps
features.summary: Reverse works with Speed, Fit to, the ⌥ rate stretch and speed ramps; a reversed ramped clip ramps through the file backwards.
features.where: Clip tab ▸ Clip ▸ Timing section ▸ Reverse

features.name: The Reversing sheet
features.summary: Turning on Reverse for a file with no copy shows a progress sheet while Frame Job renders a backwards copy once.

features.name: The backwards copy is shared
features.summary: The backwards copy is kept in the project package and shared by every reversed clip of that file.

features.name: Reversing sheet: Cancel
features.summary: Stops the render; the sheet reads Stopping… and then explains how to try again, offering Close.

features.name: When a file cannot be reversed
features.summary: If a file cannot be reversed, the sheet says how many files failed and names the first.

features.name: A slate until the copy exists
features.summary: Until a clip's backwards copy exists it shows a slate instead of playing forwards.

features.name: Reversed clips keep depth and colour
features.summary: The backwards copy is 10-bit, at the source's exact size, with its colour information, so an HDR or log clip still looks right.

features.name: Still images have no Reverse
features.summary: A picture or freeze frame looks the same backwards, so it has no Reverse rows and nothing to render.

features.name: Freeze Frame
features.summary: Holds the frame under the playhead for 2 s by splitting the clip, opening time and filling it with a still.

features.name: Freeze Frame keeps everything in sync
features.summary: 2 s of empty time opens at the playhead across every unlocked track, so everything after it moves later together.

features.name: Freeze Frame keeps the clip's look
features.summary: The still keeps the clip's position, scale, crop and other picture settings as they were at that moment, so it lines up with the frame.

features.name: Freeze Frame on a ramped clip
features.summary: On a ramped or speed-changed clip the still holds the frame actually playing at the playhead.

features.name: Change the frozen frame
features.summary: ⌥⇧-drag the still's body to hold an earlier or later frame of the source while it stays where it is.

features.name: When Freeze Frame is available
features.summary: Freeze Frame works on a selected clip of a video file under the playhead, and is dimmed when there's none.

features.name: One kind of track for all sound
features.summary: Any track can hold a clip with sound, and every clip with sound is mixed by its own settings and its track's.

features.name: The fixed signal order
features.summary: Sound passes through a clip's settings in one fixed order, from Voice Isolation to Limiter, with Volume, fades and ducking last.

features.name: Sound on a nest
features.summary: On a nest clip, Volume, Mute, the fades, Mix to mono and ducking work, and the other Sound sections do nothing.
features.where: Clip tab ▸ Sound, with a nest clip selected

features.name: Sound analysis after import
features.summary: Frame Job analyses each file's sound on your Mac after import. Until that's done, the tools that measure a clip skip it or stop.

features.name: The Sound sub-tab
features.summary: When the selection includes a clip that plays sound, the Clip tab shows a Sound sub-tab with fifteen sections.

features.name: Section summaries
features.summary: Each Sound section header shows a one-line summary of its state, such as '+3.5 dB', '2 on' or 'Space: Hall 100%'.

features.name: Section Reset buttons
features.summary: Each Sound section header has a Reset button that appears when the section differs from its default.
features.where: Clip tab ▸ Sound ▸ section headers ▸ Reset

features.name: Quick-pick values
features.summary: Most Sound number fields have a chevron that opens a short menu of common values.

features.name: Editing several clips at once
features.summary: Changing a Sound control with several clips selected changes all of them, and a control whose clips differ is marked mixed.

features.name: Change sound settings with an agent
features.summary: An agent can change any Sound setting on one or more clips in one call with set_audio, and read it back with get_project.

features.name: Clip volume
features.summary: Sets the clip's level from 0 to 3200 %. The slider stops at 400 %, so type in the field to go higher.

features.name: Gain readout
features.summary: Shows the volume in decibels, or 'silent' at 0 %.

features.name: Loudness readout
features.summary: Shows the clip's integrated loudness and true peak at volume 100 %, over the part of the file it plays.

features.name: At volume readout
features.summary: Shows the same reading with the clip's Volume applied, and through its Limiter when that's on.
features.where: Clip tab ▸ Sound ▸ Volume ▸ At volume

features.name: Mute a clip
features.summary: Silences the clip without changing its volume.

features.name: Reset the Volume section
features.summary: Puts the volume back to 100 % and turns Mute off.

features.name: The volume line
features.summary: Every clip with sound except a nest clip draws a thin white line over its waveform showing the level you hear from it over time.

features.name: Volume action markers
features.summary: A small square in the action colour marks each action end that sets the volume.

features.name: Drag the line
features.summary: Drag the line up or down to change the clip's Volume, or the end level of the action that sets the level there.

features.name: Add a volume point
features.summary: ⌥-clicking the line adds an action ending at the level already there, so nothing changes until you drag.

features.name: Move or remove a volume point
features.summary: Drag a point's action band to move it in time, or select the band and press ⌫ to remove it.

features.name: Clicks on the line that reach the clip
features.summary: ⇧-click, ⌥⇧-drag and a double-click on the line act on the clip, as they do anywhere else on it.

features.name: Sound settings in an action
features.summary: With an action selected, most Sound controls, from Volume and Pan to the EQ and Limiter, set where the action ends.
features.where: Clip tab ▸ Sound, with an action selected

features.name: Numbers glide, switches jump
features.summary: Numbers move smoothly across an action, and switches change at the action's end with no glide.
features.where: Clip tab ▸ Sound, with an action selected

features.name: Processing turned on by an action
features.summary: A clip gets the preparation its sound needs when an action asks for it, even if the clip's own setting is off.
features.where: Clip tab ▸ Sound, with an action selected

features.name: What cannot be animated
features.summary: Ducking, Keep pitch, the fade shapes, the Voice Effect and a nest clip's Mix to mono always change the clip's own settings.
features.where: Clip tab ▸ Sound, with an action selected

features.name: Fade in and Fade out
features.summary: Set how long the clip's sound takes to rise from silence at its start and fall to silence at its end.

features.name: In shape and Out shape
features.summary: Give each fade one of four curves: Linear, S-Curve, +3 dB or −3 dB.

features.name: Fade handles on the timeline
features.summary: Every clip with sound has a small square handle at each top corner of its audio part. Drag one inward to set the fade.

features.name: Fades when a clip moves or is trimmed
features.summary: A fade travels with the clip when moved and stays at the edge when trimmed.

features.name: Crossfade Audio
features.summary: A transition between two overlapping clips fades the outgoing sound out and the incoming sound in. It's on by default.
features.where: Clip tab ▸ Clip ▸ Transition ▸ Crossfade Audio

features.name: Crossfade Shape
features.summary: Pick the curve of a transition's audio crossfade: +3 dB, Linear, S-Curve or −3 dB.
features.where: Clip tab ▸ Clip ▸ Transition ▸ Crossfade Shape

features.name: Audio-only transitions
features.summary: Two overlapping clips with no picture get the same section, and only their sound changes.

features.name: Crossfading after Detach Audio
features.summary: After Detach Audio the crossfade belongs to the audio clips: overlap them and they get a transition of their own.

features.name: Clip pan
features.summary: Moves a stereo clip's balance left or right.

features.name: Pan position readout
features.summary: Shows the pan in words: 'centre', or the side and amount, such as 'left 30'.

features.name: Mix to mono
features.summary: Averages all the clip's channels into one and sends it to every channel.
features.where: Clip tab ▸ Sound ▸ Mix ▸ Mix to mono

features.name: Reset the Mix section
features.summary: Sets the pan back to centre and turns Mix to mono off.

features.name: Channels
features.summary: Chooses which channels of a stereo file play: Both, Left Only, Right Only, or Swap Left and Right.

features.name: Normalize
features.summary: Sets each selected clip's volume from a measurement of the clip.

features.name: Normalize mode
features.summary: Choose whether Normalize aims at a Peak or a Loudness.
features.where: Clip tab ▸ Sound ▸ Volume ▸ Normalize row

features.name: Normalize loudness target
features.summary: Sets the level in LUFS that Normalize and Enhance Voice aim at, from −50 to −5. The default is −16.
features.where: Clip tab ▸ Sound ▸ Volume ▸ Normalize row

features.name: Normalize Loudness mode
features.summary: Sets each clip's volume so its integrated loudness reaches the target, so clips match.
features.where: Clip tab ▸ Sound ▸ Volume ▸ Normalize row ▸ Loudness

features.name: Normalize Peak mode
features.summary: Sets each clip's volume so its loudest moment reaches −1 dBFS.
features.where: Clip tab ▸ Sound ▸ Volume ▸ Normalize row ▸ Peak

features.name: What Normalize measures
features.summary: Normalize measures the clip over the part that plays, not the mix, so volume, fades, ducking, mute, solo and the track don't count.

features.name: Measuring through processing
features.summary: In Loudness mode, a clip with EQ, clean-up, dynamics or a voice effect is rendered through them and its volume set from the result.

features.name: The Measuring Sound sheet
features.summary: A sheet shows progress ('Clip 1 of 2…') with Cancel while clips are measured through their processing.

features.name: Clips Normalize skips
features.summary: Clips Normalize can't measure, such as nests, silent clips and clips not analysed yet, are left out and the rest are done.

features.name: Enhance Voice
features.summary: Sets each selected clip up for speech from its own measurements, in one undo step, writing ordinary settings you can see and change.

features.name: Enhance Voice: rumble cut
features.summary: Enhance Voice always sets the EQ's Rumble Cut, 80 Hz at 24 dB/oct, and keeps the EQ's other parts.

features.name: Enhance Voice: noisy pauses
features.summary: When the pauses are noisy, Enhance Voice turns on voice isolation or noise reduction, and a gate fitted to the pauses.

features.name: Enhance Voice: leveller
features.summary: Enhance Voice turns on the leveller at its defaults when the speech's short-term loudness range is over 6 LU.

features.name: Enhance Voice: de-esser
features.summary: Enhance Voice turns on the de-esser at its defaults when at least 5 % of the speech has a hot 's' band.

features.name: Enhance Voice: compressor, limiter and final volume
features.summary: Enhance Voice finishes with a compressor from the voice's own level, then the limiter and the volume that reach the target.

features.name: Clips Enhance Voice skips
features.summary: Enhance Voice leaves out what Normalize in Loudness mode does, plus clips with under 1 second of speech or not analysed yet.

features.name: Check Enhance Voice's gate by ear
features.summary: Enhance Voice sets the gate from the pauses it measured, so on very soft word starts, listen and lower the threshold if you need to.

features.name: Match Audio
features.summary: Gives the selected clips the loudness and tone of one of them, the reference, in one undo step.

features.name: Choose the reference clip
features.summary: Chooses the reference clip, which itself is not changed.

features.name: Match loudness
features.summary: Brings each other clip to the reference's loudness, as Normalize in Loudness mode does.

features.name: Match EQ
features.summary: Compares each clip's speech spectrum with the reference's and fits the EQ to the difference.

features.name: When a clip can't be matched
features.summary: A clip that can't be matched is skipped. If the reference can't be used or nothing matches, the foot of the inspector says why.

features.name: Voice Isolation
features.summary: Keeps the voice and removes background noise and room echo, using Apple's on-device voice model, so nothing leaves your Mac.

features.name: Isolate voice
features.summary: Turns isolation on at 80 %, or off.
features.where: Clip tab ▸ Sound ▸ Voice Isolation ▸ Isolate voice

features.name: Voice Isolation amount
features.summary: How much of the isolated voice replaces the clip's own sound.
features.where: Clip tab ▸ Sound ▸ Voice Isolation ▸ Amount

features.name: Voice Isolation status
features.summary: Shows what the isolated voice is doing, such as Rendering…, Ready or Plays without it at this speed.
features.where: Clip tab ▸ Sound ▸ Voice Isolation ▸ Status

features.name: Voice Isolation's background render
features.summary: The isolated voice is worked out once per clip in the background, and the clip plays without it until it's ready.

features.name: Voice Isolation and speed
features.summary: Isolation plays only at normal speed; a speed change, ramp or freeze frame plays without it and Status says so.
features.where: Clip tab ▸ Sound ▸ Voice Isolation ▸ Status

features.name: Remove noise
features.summary: How much steady background noise to remove, working out the noise level from the clip itself.
features.where: Clip tab ▸ Sound ▸ Noise Reduction ▸ Remove noise

features.name: Noise Reduction depth readout
features.summary: Shows the most any part of the sound can be turned down at this setting, such as '6 dB at most'.
features.where: Clip tab ▸ Sound ▸ Noise Reduction ▸ Depth

features.name: Remove hum
features.summary: Turns hum removal on, notching out mains hum and its harmonics.
features.where: Clip tab ▸ Sound ▸ Hum ▸ Remove hum

features.name: Hum mains frequency
features.summary: The mains frequency where the recording was made, 50 Hz or 60 Hz.

features.name: Hum depth
features.summary: How far each notch turns the hum down.

features.name: Hum harmonics
features.summary: How many notches: the mains frequency and its multiples.

features.name: Gate pauses
features.summary: Turns the gate on, pushing sound below the threshold further down so room noise and breaths between phrases get quieter.
features.where: Clip tab ▸ Sound ▸ Gate ▸ Gate pauses

features.name: Gate threshold
features.summary: How far under the clip's loudness the gate opens.

features.name: Gate ratio
features.summary: How strongly sound under the threshold is turned down.

features.name: Gate range
features.summary: The most the gate ever takes away.

features.name: Gate attack
features.summary: How quickly it opens when the sound rises.

features.name: Gate hold
features.summary: How long it stays open after the sound falls, so word ends are not clipped.

features.name: Gate release
features.summary: How quickly it closes after the hold.

features.name: Gate Status and Loudness readouts
features.summary: Readouts say where the gate opens on this clip, why it's waiting or not working, and the loudness it's measured from.

features.name: Waiting for the clip's loudness
features.summary: Until a clip's loudness is measured it plays without the gate, leveller and de-esser, and an export waits for it.
features.where: Clip tab ▸ Sound ▸ Gate, Leveller or De-esser

features.name: Reduce sibilance
features.summary: Turns the de-esser on, turning down only the band above its frequency while it is over the threshold.
features.where: Clip tab ▸ Sound ▸ De-esser ▸ Reduce sibilance

features.name: De-esser frequency
features.summary: Where the sibilant band starts.

features.name: De-esser threshold
features.summary: How loud the band must get, relative to the clip's loudness, before it is turned down.

features.name: De-esser range
features.summary: The most the band is turned down.

features.name: De-esser Status and Loudness readouts
features.summary: Readouts say where the de-esser acts on this clip, why it's waiting or not working, and the loudness it's measured from.

features.name: EQ
features.summary: Shape the clip's tone with seven parts, each with its own checkbox: a high-pass, two shelves, three bands and a low-pass.

features.name: The EQ response curve
features.summary: The EQ's first row draws how much each frequency from 20 Hz to 20 kHz is turned up or down, hum notches included.

features.name: EQ Bypass
features.summary: Switches the EQ off without losing its settings, so you can compare with and without.

features.name: EQ presets
features.summary: Rumble Cut, De-mud and Presence each set one EQ part in one press, so they combine.

features.name: EQ High-pass
features.summary: Turns down everything below its Frequency.

features.name: EQ Low shelf
features.summary: Turns everything below its Frequency up or down by its Gain.
features.where: Clip tab ▸ Sound ▸ EQ ▸ Low shelf

features.name: EQ Band 1, 2 and 3
features.summary: Turns the frequencies around each Frequency up or down by its Gain, with Q setting how narrow.

features.name: EQ High shelf
features.summary: Turns everything above its Frequency up or down by its Gain.
features.where: Clip tab ▸ Sound ▸ EQ ▸ High shelf

features.name: EQ Low-pass
features.summary: Turns down everything above its Frequency.

features.name: EQ Frequency, Gain, Q and Slope
